data.title: 空门苍 · 粗点心店的狡黠投喂
data.description: 老街粗点心店的柜台后，苍围着绿色围裙趴在玻璃柜上。她用手指捏起一枚酸味软糖直接递到眼前，眉眼弯弯地带着恶作剧成功的狡黠笑容。
data.location: retro Japanese dagashi candy store filled with colorful jars and snack bags
data.action: leaning over glass display case in green apron, holding up a sour gummy candy to feed the viewer, winking with a cheeky mischievous grin
data.lighting: warm amber glow of incandescent bulbs highlighting her energetic blue eyes and coral tee
data.mood: playful girlfriend tease, sweet everyday banter, lively vibrant charm
data.promptProse: Leaning across the candy shop glass counter in a green apron, Ao playfully feeds a sweet treat to the viewer with a sparkling cheeky smile.
data.animaCaption: Ao leaning over the retro candy counter offering a treat with a mischievous grin.
